title: What's New: AL-Go for GitHub on Delivery and Deployment (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Dependency Install Mode Demo and Configuration
Pull Request Deployment Demo and Artifact Expiration

features.name: Dependency Install Mode
features.description: A setting that determines how dependencies are handled at deploy time. Allows automatic installation or upgrade of dependencies from AppSource if not included in the app being deployed.

features.name: Test Apps Deployment
features.description: Feature to deploy test apps to sandbox environments during deployment. Includes ability to exclude apps by ID. Automatically excludes test apps that depend on unavailable test libraries.
caveats: Test apps are only deployed to sandbox environments
Performance test apps with unavailable dependencies are automatically excluded

features.name: Pull Request Artifact Deployment
features.description: Allows deploying artifacts from a pull request directly to an online environment for quick testing before merging. Currently requires manual workflow trigger with PR ID. Future versions may automate this on each PR push.
caveats: Pull request artifacts expire after one day by default
Only works with apps built in that specific PR - remaining apps come from last known good build

features.name: Incremental Builds with PR Artifacts
features.description: When incremental builds are enabled, only apps built in a specific PR are published as artifacts, with remaining apps sourced from the last known good build to save storage costs.

features.name: Automatic Test App Exclusion by Dependencies
features.description: Test apps are automatically excluded from deployment if they depend on test libraries that are not available as AppSource apps.
